lib/paint/style: StampPainting loads a scene's three.js sources on its device's owner and renders them each frame.
lib/paint/shot: A shot draws a three.js source as the three layers build it, with its painted textures.
lib/paint/gate: The gate loads a three.js cylinder through the three-source loader, its material reading a painted texture as a shot's three source would; and builds the lit shot's stands as three sources (soft shadows, a planar mirror pass following the camera), loading one apart to render exposures and reading them through the camera a three plane renders through (painted-three-camera); and builds paper cards and pop-ups (paintedThreePopUp) from prints it writes, posing their rig to read where each card lands.
lib/paint/paper-kit: The paper kit builds cut-paper constructions as pop-up sheets: folded faces, hinges and the pop-up rig's sheets standing on each other.
